title: Nebula Serpent Apothecary
description: A green-skinned humanoid with flowing blue hair sits on a wooden crate labeled 'Spellforge Garden 825' painting a small bottle. Behind them is a weathered stone building with a large window sign reading 'Nebula Serpent Apothecary' and 'Elixirs Grown Here'. A massive glowing blue skull with yellow eyes floats in the starry night sky above, surrounded by aurora-like light and magical vines.
prompt: A green-skinned fantasy alchemist with long flowing blue hair sits cross-legged on a wooden crate labeled Spellforge Garden 825, carefully painting a potion bottle with a brush. Behind is a crumbling stone wall covered in glowing vines and mushrooms with a large wooden window sign that reads Nebula Serpent Apothecary and Elixirs Grown Here. Various labeled potion bottles sit on shelves. A giant glowing blue skull with bright yellow eyes floats in a dark night sky filled with stars and swirling blue and green aurora lights.
